experiments.hypothesis: Third story-arm slot beats mature clip baseline on views-per-hour
experiments.change: Registered the already-live story-vs-clip split as a tracked experiment (state/third_packages/default_clip.json story_count=1; scripts/run_third.py date-seeded story-slot assignment with genuine-arc fallback, run_third.py:2522-2546). No change to the six-post target or any quality gate. Scoped on actual_structure (shared/experiments.py) so a slot that fell back to a plain clip is never counted as a story sample.
experiments.metric: third.ab_experiment.story.median_vph (mature 24h+, vs the clip arm on the same measure)

experiments.hypothesis: Superlative/science-family explainer topics beat the broad mix on average-view-percentage
experiments.change: post_stories.py reserves one explainer slot per day for the next unposted superlative-titled story (largest/hottest/strongest/deadliest/oldest/loudest/longest/driest/fastest/deepest/biggest/most) ahead of plain queue order, when one is waiting and none has posted yet that day (_reserve_superlative_slot). No change to cadence, quality bar, or the topic doctrine. Every posted-log entry is tagged experiment_arm/actual_structure=superlative_topic|other_topic by _creative_facts so fetch_analytics and shared.experiments can join outcome to topic family per video, scoped so a fallback cannot corrupt the count.
experiments.metric: explainer.average_view_percentage (mature, age-banded vs the other_topic arm)
